manifest.name: deepcode
manifest.description: deepcode — an opencode-style full-screen terminal UI for DeepSeek Harness, packaged as a dsh bundle plugin.

bundle.text:
# deepcode bundle patch: an opencode-style terminal UI over dsh-base.
#
# It mirrors the web surface's host/agent split: dsh-base stays the shared
# host plane (sandbox, approval, persistence, model route, the tool/skill
# registries), while the conversation plane — persona, tools, skills, plan
# mode, goals, subagents — moves behind the agent preset, exactly like the web
# app. The only thing this bundle adds on top is the terminal runner.

# ── the terminal runner (the one deepcode-owned row) ────────────────────────

- insert:
    # dsh-base omits this row; the web surface adds it, and the TUI needs it
    # for the same preset-driven conversation. The roster scans the plugin's
    # SHIPPED root by default (`includeShippedRoot`), which is the current
    # `standard` / `ptc` / `minimal` / `cordis` set — no copied profile root,
    # which would shadow them with a stale snapshot. Settings
    # `agent-presets.default` overrides `default` here.
    - id: agent-presets
      name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-agent-presets'
      config:
        default: ptc

    - id: tui-runner
      name: 'deepcode'
      inject: [agents, agentDefaultModel, sessions]

# Full-text session search is opt-in (dsh-base keeps the sqlite index closed
# with `openAt: never`). The /session picker search uses the host service
# (`sessionQuery.searchSessions` — the same SQLite FTS the web calls), so this
# layer enables it lazily on a durable index: the first search builds it, later
# searches reuse it.
- id: session-query-sqlite
  config:
    path: !!js dshHomePath('profiles/deepcode/session-search.sqlite')
    openAt: first-search

# Whole-log session statistics (LLM/tool wall times, TTFT, counts) as a
# projection unit — the same plugin the web composes for its stats.
- insert:
    - id: session-stats
      name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-session-stats'

    # Host-owned opt-in the preset delegation tools sample: without it the
    # `tool-subagent` row in the standard/ptc presets refuses to mount
    # ("requires @deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-subagent/model-selection-settings in the
    # Host scope"). The web surface composes the same host row.
    - id: subagent-model-selection-settings
      name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-subagent/model-selection-settings'

    # Workspace registry: the durable grouping the web sidebar reads (a
    # Workspace owns an ordered `sessionIds` account). dsh-base omits this row
    # — only dsh-web-app composes it — so without it every session this TUI
    # creates is missing from the web sidebar's workspace grouping and shows
    # up under "未分组" instead. Sharing one registry is what makes the two
    # surfaces agree: the web's RPC controller and the API session controller
    # both read this same account.
    - id: workspace
      name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-workspace'

    # Cordis runtime services (dynamicCordisRunner, cordisInspect). The
    # `创造模式` (cordis) preset carries a `tool-cordis` row that injects both,
    # so without this host row that preset cannot mount at all and every
    # session recorded on it fails to load ("preset \"cordis\" failed to
    # mount ... waiting for dynamicCordisRunner, cordisInspect"). Like the
    # workspace row, this is another capability dsh-base omits and only
    # dsh-web-app composes.
    - id: cordis-host-runner
      name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-cordis-host-runner'

# ── shared surface values (same as web / headless) ──────────────────────────

- id: system-prompt
  config:
    persona: >-
      You are a coding agent powered by the {{model}} model. Your working directory is {{cwd}}.

- id: hmr
  disabled: true

- id: tools
  config:
    mode: !!js process.env.DSH_TOOLS_MODE

# ── the agent plane moves behind agent presets (mirrors dsh-web-app) ────────
#
# dsh-base keeps these process-wide; the web surface disables them so each
# session's preset owns them. The TUI is also preset-driven, so it disables the
# same rows. (Code Mode's `code-runtime` stays a host-plane capability, as in
# web, and needs no disable here.)

- id: agent-instructions
  disabled: true

- id: tool-bash
  disabled: true

- id: tool-pwsh
  disabled: true

- id: tool-fs
  disabled: true

# tool-fs-search stays enabled — the TUI needs the glob tool for the @ file
# mention picker (dsh-at-file will be added when network is available).

- id: tool-str-replace-editor
  disabled: true

- id: tool-jobs
  disabled: true

- id: tool-todo
  disabled: true

- id: tool-web
  disabled: true

- id: skill-filesystem
  disabled: true

- id: tool-skill
  disabled: true

- id: tool-goal
  disabled: true

- id: plan-mode
  disabled: true

- id: compaction-basic
  disabled: true

- id: command-compact
  disabled: true

- id: tool-result-pruner
  disabled: true

- id: tool-subagent
  disabled: true

- id: tool-subagent-control
  disabled: true

- id: tool-subagent-list-agents
  disabled: true

- id: tool-subagent-fork
  disabled: true

- id: tool-workflow
  disabled: true

- id: workflow-worker-thread
  disabled: true

- id: tool-ralph
  disabled: true

readme.text:
`deepcode` 是一个 opencode 风格的 **DeepSeek Harness 全屏终端 UI**，按 harness 的 bundle 插件规范打包（镜像 `dsh-headless`）。输入 `deepcode` 即可在终端里与 harness 的 Agent 交互——流式对话、思考过程、工具调用卡片、审批与提问应答，不需要打开浏览器。

它复用 harness 的 `dsh` 启动器与 `dsh-base` 核心（Agent / Session / 全部工具 / 审批 / 模型 / preset），本仓库只提供终端 UI 这一层。

需要 Node.js ≥ 20 与 npm。

```bash
cd /home/fongye/code/deepcode
npm install      # 安装 @deepseek-ai/dsh + ink + react
npm link         # 注册 `deepcode` 命令
```

之后任意目录直接运行：

```bash
deepcode
```

首次运行会自动写入 `$DSH_HOME/profiles/deepcode/` 的 profile 清单并把本 bundle 链接进解析路径，无需额外 `dsh plugin` 步骤。

- 直接输入文字 + 回车发送；
- `Ctrl+C`：Agent 运行中 → 打断本轮；空闲 → 退出；
- `/quit` 或 `/exit` 退出。

```text
cordis.patch.yml   bundle patch：插入 agent-presets + tui-runner 两行
lib/index.js       runner 插件（导出 { name, inject, apply }）
lib/controller.js  Agent 包装：创建/发送/打断 + 会话事件折叠成转录（流式）
lib/app.js         Ink UI：头部 / 消息列表 / 工具卡片 / 输入 / 审批与提问

`package.json` 通过 `"dsh": { "bundle": { "patch": "./cordis.patch.yml" } }` 声明这是 bundle；`dsh --profile deepcode` 会组合 `@deepseek-ai/dsh-base` + 本 bundle。

没有 TTY 时可用环境变量验证「bundle 解析 + Agent 创建 + preset 挂载 + 模型读取」整条链路：

```bash
DEEPCODE_SMOKE=1 deepcode

- 模型切换 UI（`ctx.llm.listModels` + `agentDefaultModel.saveSelection`）
- 历史会话列表与恢复（`sessionQuery.listSessions` + `agents.resume`）
- 计划模式 / 目标 / 子代理等面板的可视化
- 交互式审批与提问的端到端验证（需真实 TTY）

API 契约参考见 [`docs/tui-api-reference.md`](docs/tui-api-reference.md)（依据 `@deepseek-ai/*` 0.1.0-rc.6 源码整理）。
